scope: read-only peer code/data review of current recompute_blender.py/recompute_stl.py and their two result JSONs; independent scalar cross-checks using raw vertices/STL struct; no Blender rerun and no imports of existing checker or recompute code
conclusion: No blocking numerical error found within declared bounds/volume/edge-topology and selected geometry scope. Current data supports 448 mm² nominal two exposed rail ledges, approximately 0.4 mm narrow material between markers, and construction/exposed tenon heights 30/29.5 mm. It does not certify complete STL/source surface identity, printability, support-free manufacture, material strength, assembly feasibility, or qualified fit.

readOnly.calcLoopTrianglesMeaning: in-memory tessellation/cache only; source file not saved
readOnly.limitations: Audit did not inspect Blender launch command/process independently here; reported --background/--disable-autoexec method is code/output metadata. Existing result hashes and 11 disk scene hashes were read and checked.

unitsAndTransforms.sceneToMm: matrix_world @ local vertex first, then scene.scale_length*1000
unitsAndTransforms.stlUnits: STL contains no unit field; parsed numeric coordinates are interpreted as millimeters by this project
unitsAndTransforms.itemVsWorld: item_dimensions_mm is obj.dimensions; world_bounds comes from transformed vertices, so rotated objects are not compared by Item Dimensions
unitsAndTransforms.scopeCaution: obj.data is unevaluated base mesh. No claim here that this generic code validates unapplied modifiers or rendered/evaluated surface; current finalized objects are prior published applied geometry.

railIndependentCheck.method: Filter actual Body polygons at world Z≈10, signed XY shoelace negative for -Z orientation; independent of Blender triangle-area output
railIndependentCheck.nominalCalculation: 2 × (56 mm exposed interior length) × (4 mm width) = 448 mm²
railIndependentCheck.not480Reason: Construction rails span60, but 2mm end walls on each side leave X−28..28 exposed beneath rails; external end-wall material is not unsupported ledge
railIndependentCheck.interpretation: Horizontal downward ledges in this original opening-up geometry; no determination of slicer support, bridge feasibility, final orientation, or actual print failure.

markerIndependentCheck.nominalCalculation: 1.6 mm center pitch − 1.2 mm faceted circumdiameter = 0.4 mm material
markerIndependentCheck.methodValidity: Bounding-circle center-minus-X-radius formula is valid for these same-Y, aligned 32-gon floor profiles with opposing X extrema. It is not a general closest surface distance algorithm.
markerIndependentCheck.manufacturingCaution: Nozzle0.4mm does not fix extrusion line width. A 0.4mm nominal web creates a fine-feature risk; this check does not demonstrate that it is exactly one extruded line or that marks merge in actual printing.

tenonIndependentCheck.definitions: 30 mm construction tool includes nominal0.5mm into bottom;29.5mm is geometric exposed height from nominal inner floor−13 to top16.5. Neither is verified mechanical effective free length.
tenonIndependentCheck.minorPrecisionNote: root subtracts nominal−13 instead of actual float floor−13.000000617; difference6.17e−7mm is far below numerical epsilon and does not alter29.5mm nominal statement.
tenonIndependentCheck.potentialRisk: Existing lip and locating post may compete under actual manufacturing error; geometry alone does not prove actual overconstraint failure or successful fit.

checksPresent: Bounds and volume compared against new transformed source readback
stlReview.quantizationCaution: round(x/1e−5) hashes coordinates to grid; this is not a Euclidean weld tolerance. It may merge close distinct points or separate close points across a bin boundary in arbitrary data.
stlReview.storedNormalCheckLimitation: root dot(cr,normal)>0 only checks same hemisphere, not angular/unit accuracy. Additional direct struct check on these10 actual STLs found finite values, minimum cosine≥0.9999999999999982, maximum angular deviation≈3.42e−6degrees and norm≈0.999999912..1.000000090.
stlReview.topologyInterpretation: nonmanifold_edges0/components1 means these chosen edge-incidence/vertex-graph tests pass under declared quantization. Bounds+volume+these topology indicators do not prove geometric equality or printability.
stlReview.assertionScope: dimensions_and_topology_consistent field is acceptable if described as the listed metrics; do not render as complete source/STL shape equivalence or certified watertight solid.

findings.title: Do not promote scalar/topology comparisons to complete surface identity
findings.requiredWording: 本次重算核對尺寸、體積與指定邊拓撲指標；完整面覆蓋／形狀相等是不同檢查，不能由這次指標推得。

findings.title: Use geometric exposed tenon height rather than verified mechanical free length
findings.requiredWording: 柱工具高30mm，內底以上幾何露出高約29.5mm；力學有效長度與實體穩定性未驗證。

findings.title: 0.4mm fine web and448mm² downward ledges are geometry risks, not observed print failure
findings.requiredWording: 噴嘴不等於線寬；支撐/橋接/方向須切片與列印驗證。
